title: Full-production spectral discretization to continuum PDE
statement: Conditional on A2-H3-CANONICAL-PRODUCTION-FUNCTIONAL, for the canonical full-production P1/P2 gradient flow on the fixed three-torus, eta_shell=0, initial H2 radii R in {0.5,1,2}, tau=0.02, and T=0.2, explicit finite B6(R,tau,T) and C(R,tau,T) bound the positive-time H6 solution ball and the collocation/Galerkin residual mismatch by C N^-2. A separately derived energy/coercivity envelope bounds the exact Galerkin trajectory restarted at tau from P_N u(tau), which converges to P_N u in L2 uniformly on [tau,T] at explicit rate E(R,tau,T)N^-4. Independent full-chain and executable audits, the finite-grid evidence matrix, and the replacement PUBLISHED reproduction bundle support the theorem.
scope: T6 CONDITIONAL-THEOREM: fixed T3 with periods 16, canonical hash-pinned P1/P2 functional and coefficients, positive rho and Class-II mass regularisers, eta_shell=0, H2 initial radii R=0.5,1,2, tau=0.02, T=0.2, and exact nonlinear projection P_N N(u_N). Conditional on A2-H3-CANONICAL-PRODUCTION-FUNCTIONAL. The theorem is positive-time and restarted; it excludes t=0 algebraic rates for merely H2 data, finite-oversampling exactness for the rational Class-II term, practical-grid error certification, historical solver trajectories, eta_shell nonzero, removed regularisers, and infinite volume.
falsifier: A failed source hash or 124-assertion verifier; an incorrect Fourier shell, semigroup, endpoint-cancellation, Class-II coefficient/contraction, continuum or Galerkin energy ball, directed-rounding, projection-tail, Gronwall, or alias estimate; a counterexample to the stated positive-time H6/residual bounds; failure of the exact Galerkin energy identity or N^-4 estimate; or a broken replacement bundle digest invalidates this T6 theorem and reopens A3-FULL-DISCRETIZATION-CLOSURE.
no_overclaim: T6 is conditional on the canonical-functional identification. The derived constants are finite but not practically sharp. This claim does not assert an algebraic rate from t=0 for merely H2 data, exactness of any fixed finite oversampling rule for the rational Class-II term, a controlled error bar for historical N32/N64/N128 Sector-B trajectories, full-spectrum Hessian convergence, all-device GPU equivalence, minimizer or BCC selection, T7, or physical-domain closure.
